map.纯前端网络工具箱：多源 IP 查询、任意 IP 归属、本机内网 IP、站点可达性: A client-side network toolbox: multi-source IP lookup, arbitrary IP geolocation, local private IP, site reachability, URL probe, WebRTC leak, NAT type, DNS egress, CDN edge, proxy routing, speed test, browser fingerprint and service status. All runs locally in your browser - no backend, no API keys, no uploads.

map.13 项纯前端网络诊断工具：IP 查询、可达性、WebRTC 泄露、NAT 推断: 13 client-side network diagnostics: IP lookup, reachability, WebRTC leak, NAT, CDN, speed test, fingerprint. No backend, no keys, no uploads.
map.全部工具在浏览器本地运行：网络请求用 fetch/WebRTC/Image 发起: All tools run locally in the browser: network requests use fetch/WebRTC/Image, with timeouts controlled by AbortController or timers. Results are written only to this page and localStorage - no uploads, no analytics. Reachability tools can only tell whether the network layer accepts a request; HTTP status codes are unreadable (no-cors returns an opaque response), so conclusions are heuristic. DNS egress lookup, which requires your own domain/server, degrades explicitly when unconfigured and never fabricates data.
map.隐私说明：本页不埋点、不上报。网络类结果受本地网络、浏览器 CORS 策略与第三: Privacy: this page has no analytics or reporting. Network results depend on your local network, browser CORS policy and third-party availability, and are for reference only; one tool failing does not affect the others. Every external request has a timeout, and failures show the reason with a retry option.
map.展示公网 IP、版本、地区、ISP、ASN、时区与数据来源。按 ipwho.is: Shows public IP, version, region, ISP, ASN, timezone and data source. Falls back ipwho.is -> ipapi.co -> api.ip.sb -> ipify; IPv6 probed separately.
map.尚未查询，点击「刷新查询」开始。: Not queried yet. Click Refresh to start.
map.输入 IPv4/IPv6 查询归属，先校验格式，合法才发请求；主源失败回退备源。: Enter an IPv4/IPv6 address to look up its geolocation. Format is validated before any request; falls back to a secondary source. Press Enter to submit.
map.用无 STUN 的 WebRTC host candidate 收集本机内网地址: Collects local private addresses via WebRTC host candidates without STUN. Browsers may return mDNS-obfuscated addresses, shown separately.
map.需按钮点击触发（浏览器手势要求）。3 秒后自动关闭连接。: Requires a button click (browser gesture policy). Connection closes after 3 seconds.
map.并发探测 Google / GitHub / Cloudflare / Open: Probes favicons of Google / GitHub / Cloudflare / OpenAI concurrently (limit 5), recording reachability and approximate latency.
map.favicon 改版或 CDN 拦截可能导致误判，结果仅供参考。: Favicon changes or CDN blocking may cause false results; for reference only.
map.输入 URL（无协议自动补 https://），先用 fetch no-cors: Enter a URL (https:// added automatically). Uses fetch no-cors to test network-layer reachability, falling back to a favicon image probe.
map.no-cors 无法读取状态码，只能判断请求是否被网络层接受。: no-cors cannot read status codes; it only tells whether the request was accepted at the network layer.
map.用公共 STUN 收集全部 ICE 候选，解析 IP / 类型 / 协议，与 T: Collects all ICE candidates via a public STUN server, parses IP / type / protocol, compares with the T1 public IP, and lists private or mDNS addresses.
map.需按钮点击触发；5 秒后关闭连接。URL 参数 stun= 可自定义 STUN。: Requires a button click; connection closes after 5 seconds. Use the stun= URL parameter to customize the STUN server.
map.尚未检测。建议先运行 T1 以获得公网 IP 用于比对。: Not tested yet. Run T1 first to obtain a public IP for comparison.
map.向 3 个公共 STUN 分别取 srflx 映射的 IP:端口，按端口是否一致: Queries srflx IP:port mappings from 3 public STUN servers and infers cone vs symmetric NAT from port consistency.
map.基于 STUN 的启发式推断，非精确检测，受多出口与运营商 NAT 层级影响。: Heuristic inference based on STUN, not an exact detection; affected by multiple egresses and carrier NAT layers.
map.需自有域名与权威 DNS 日志才能反映递归解析器出口 IP；未配置时明确降级，不: Requires your own domain and authoritative DNS logging to reveal the recursive resolver's egress IP. Degrades explicitly when unconfigured; no fabricated results.
map.降级行为：本页默认不配置任何自有域名接口，点击只会显示配置说明，不会生成假数据。: Fallback: no domain endpoint is configured by default; clicking only shows setup instructions and never generates fake data.
map.需配置自有域名后才能使用。: Requires your own domain to use.
map.请求同一 CDN 的静态小文件，读取 cf-ray / x-served-by: Requests small static files from a CDN and reads cf-ray / x-served-by / x-cache headers; falls back to a minimum-RTT latency fingerprint when headers are hidden.
map.CORS 可能隐藏 CDN 专有头，结果可能不完整。: CORS may hide CDN-specific headers; results may be incomplete.
map.分别探测国内组与国外组站点，按通过数推断可能的代理模式，并给出逐项明细。: Probes domestic and global site groups, infers a possible proxy mode from pass counts, and lists per-target details.
map.启发式推断，非读取系统代理配置；favicon 可达性受 CDN 与站点改版影响: Heuristic inference, not a read of system proxy settings; favicon reachability is affected by CDNs and site redesigns.
map.用 Cloudflare 测速端点：预热 256KB → 10 次小请求取延迟中: Uses Cloudflare's speed endpoint: 256KB warm-up, 10 small requests for median latency and jitter, then multi-round 1MB/5MB/10MB downloads with the median taken.
map.非专业测速，受节点与网络影响；测速时请保持页面在前台。: Not a professional speed test; affected by edge nodes and network conditions. Keep the page in the foreground while testing.
map.本地采集 UA、语言、时区、屏幕、CPU、Canvas 与 WebGL 特征，计: Collects UA, languages, timezone, screen, CPU, Canvas and WebGL traits locally and computes a SHA-256 hash.
map.全部本地计算、不上报。指纹可能被站点用于追踪，请勿将其视为匿名标识。: Computed entirely locally and never reported. Fingerprints can be used for tracking; do not treat them as anonymous identifiers.
map.聚合 GitHub / Cloudflare / Vercel / npm 的公: Aggregates public status JSON from GitHub / Cloudflare / Vercel / npm with a 5-second timeout; failures show unknown.
map.各服务状态接口 CORS 策略可能变化；读不到时显示 unknown，不猜测状态: Status endpoint CORS policies may change; unreadable endpoints show unknown and are never guessed.
map.IP 格式不合法，未发送请求。: Invalid IP format; no request sent.
map.未获取到 host candidate（浏览器可能禁用了 WebRTC 或已启用: No host candidate (WebRTC disabled or mDNS obfuscated)
map.未获取到 ICE 候选（WebRTC 不可用或 STUN 不可达）: No ICE candidates (WebRTC unavailable or STUN unreachable)
map.每个工具最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传: Each tool's last successful result is stored only in your local browser (localStorage) - never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Records disappear if you switch browsers or clear site data.
